source_lookup: Mesa src/egl/main/eglglvnd.c:74 passes GLVND getProcAddress to eglGetProcAddress; src/egl/main/eglapi.c and src/egl/drivers/dri2/egl_dri2.c previously resolved generic Mesa GL stubs.
official_egl: libEGL_mtgpu.so.0.0.0+0x342e0 tailcalls musa_glapi_get_proc_address; offsets 0x342bc/0x38617 request its glFlush.
secondary_driver: musa_dri.so+0xa704 dispatches via musa_glapi_set_dispatch; +0xa6d2 sets NULL on reset. These use libglapi_musa.so.0 thread storage.
scope: Private Linux/glibc Mesa GLVND/Wayland client opts into a fixed staged resolver before the first GL lookup. Other client processes keep their own ordinary resolver. Resolver selection persists per process through bind/unbind.
limitations: The physical log checks GL_VENDOR and GL_RENDERER together and records a missing identity before frame 1. The v9 vendor dispatch and subsequent draw/swap still require the S30 physical test.
